name: Freelancer Invoicing: First Month
persona: Solo designer billing 4-8 clients a month
goal: Get paid on time without chasing clients by hand
evidence: 12 onboarding interviews (Oct 2026), 340 support tickets tagged onboarding, funnel data for 1,180 signups

stages.name: Signup

emotions.label: Hopeful, wants the first invoice out today

pain_points: Asked for VAT number before seeing the product (7 of 12 interviews)
opportunities: Ask for VAT details only when the first invoice needs them

stages.name: First invoice
pain_points: Tax line hidden under 'More options' (41 tickets)
opportunities: Show the tax line by default for VAT-registered accounts

stages.name: Waiting to be paid
actions: Checks whether the client opened the invoice

emotions.label: Anxious, unsure the client saw it

opportunities: Show opened and viewed status on each invoice
Offer scheduled reminders at 3 and 10 days overdue

stages.name: Paid
pain_points: Partial payments must be split by hand
opportunities: Match partial payments from the bank feed

stages.name: Month end
actions: Exports income report for the accountant
pain_points: Export columns do not match the accountant's template
